maddeler.e:
أندمج (form VII)
# أَنْدَمِجُ (ʔandamiju) /ʔan.da.mi.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# أَنْدَمِجَ (ʔandamija) /ʔan.da.mi.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# أَنْدَمِجْ (ʔandamij) /ʔan.da.mid͡ʒ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
